item.title: Download YouTube Videos from the Command Line
item.description: Intro What dev doesn’t want to run stuff from the command line just to look cool? I knew about youtube-dl before but thought it looked too complicated to bother with. Tried it today and it’s actually super slick! Setup Install Python 3.7+ Just head to the Python official site and install it. Make sure to check Add Python x.x to PATH during installation.
